This bar fixes the noise in your head.

Boroda Bar on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo hits different when the sun drops. Cold drinks, real atmosphere, none of the resort-bar markup. $15-30 a person for a full night out. 4.5 stars across 297 reviews says it's not just us.

Phu Quoc's bar scene has a lot of forgettable spots. This one stays with you.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
